title: The New Desk and the Red Cup
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，注意 he / she / it、is、a / an、单数名词和 this / that 的用法。先读一遍，再回答问题。所有题目都是英文，解释是中文。这是模拟教学材料，不是官方雅思考试。
passage: This is a small office. It is new. Tom is a worker. He is at a desk. This is his desk. It is near a window. Anna is a worker too. She is at a desk. That is her desk. It is near a door. A red cup is on Tom's desk. It is a small cup. A blue pen is on Anna's desk. It is a long pen. This is a phone. It is on a table. That is a bag. It is under a chair. Tom and Anna are a team. They are happy.

questions.explanation: 文中说 Tom is a worker，所以选 A worker。
文中说 This is his desk. It is near a window. 所以 Tom 的桌子在窗户附近。
questions.evidence: This is his desk. It is near a window.

questions.explanation: 文中说 A blue pen is on Anna's desk. 所以 Anna 桌上是一支蓝色的笔。
questions.evidence: A blue pen is on Anna's desk.

questions.explanation: 文中说 A red cup is on Tom's desk. 所以杯子是红色的。
questions.evidence: A red cup is on Tom's desk.

questions.explanation: 文中说 That is a bag. It is under a chair. 所以包在椅子下面。
questions.evidence: That is a bag. It is under a chair.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence with one word from the text: Anna is a ______ too.
questions.explanation: 文中说 Anna is a worker too. 所以填 worker。

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence with one word from the text: This is a ______. It is on a table.
questions.explanation: 文中说 This is a phone. It is on a table. 所以填 phone。
questions.evidence: This is a phone. It is on a table.

questions.explanation: 文中说 They are happy. 所以 Tom 和 Anna 很开心。

grammar.title: he / she / it；is；a / an；单数名词；this / that
grammar.explanation: 英语里，he 指男性，she 指女性，it 指物品或动物。is 是 be 动词，用于 he / she / it 后面。a 用在辅音音素开头的单数名词前，an 用在元音音素开头的单数名词前。单数名词指一个东西，前面常有 a 或 an。this 指离说话人近的东西，that 指离说话人远的东西。例如：He is a worker. She is a worker. It is a cup. This is a desk. That is a bag.
grammar.example: He is at a desk. She is at a desk. It is a small cup. This is a phone. That is a bag.

questions.explanation: teacher 是人，女性用 she。It 指物品，They 是复数，所以选 She。
apple 以元音音素开头，用 an。所以选 an。
questions.evidence: A red cup is on Tom's desk.

questions.prompt: ___ is a book. It is on the desk.
questions.explanation: book 是物品，用 it。所以选 It。

questions.prompt: Tom is a man. ___ is happy.
questions.explanation: Tom 是男性，用 he。所以选 He。

questions.prompt: ___ is a pen. It is near the cup.
questions.explanation: 单数物品用 this。These 和 Those 是复数，所以选 This。

questions.prompt: Look at that bag. ___ is under the chair.
questions.explanation: bag 是物品，用 it。所以选 It。
questions.evidence: That is a bag. It is under a chair.

questions.prompt: Anna is a woman. ___ is at a desk.
questions.explanation: Anna 是女性，用 she。所以选 She。

questions.prompt: This is ___ desk. It is near a window.
questions.explanation: desk 以辅音音素开头，用 a。所以选 a。
